title: Bloodline Bond
next_chapter_hook: The jade pendant gleamed with an eerie light under the moonlight, its turtle shell material identical to the Tianji Record Fragment—Chen Ji's heart lurched, a terrifying thought emerging: was there some connection between his sister and the Tianji Record that he had never known about?

text.content: Late at night, as Chen Ji sat cross-legged practicing Tuna Breathing, a barely perceptible whooshing sound passed by the window—someone was probing his residence. His eyelashes trembled slightly, his perception extending like spider silk, but he abruptly pulled back the moment it touched that aura. Not an enemy, but... familiar Blood Pulse fluctuation. A complex smile curved Chen Ji's lips. That girl, sneaking over again.

The window frame creaked softly, a slender figure climbing through, bringing with her a faint scent of herbal medicine. Chen Nian landed soundlessly, dressed in simple cyan robes, her black hair simply pinned up with a wooden hairpin, her delicate features appearing especially soft under the moonlight. Her eyes were slightly red-rimmed, clearly having traveled a considerable distance. "Brother, I'm back." This gentle call carried a long-suppressed longing that nearly shattered Chen Ji's carefully constructed composed demeanor.

dialogue.content: "Brother, how did you lose so much weight! Are they skimping on food at the outer court again? I brought you osmanthus cake, your favorite, and pickles Mom made herself—" Chen Nian chattered on and on, taking out an oil-paper package from her embrace, her movements sprightly as a little bird, completely different from the agility she displayed when climbing through the window moments ago.

text.content: Watching his sister bustling about, Chen Ji's heart was filled with mixed emotions. He reached out and took the package that still carried her body warmth, and the moment his fingertips touched the oil paper, his throat tightened. "Why did you come?" His voice was deliberately flat. "The inner sect rules are strict—what if someone discovers you..." Before he finished, Chen Nian had already pouted and interrupted him: "So what if they discover me? Anyone who dares to give my brother trouble, I'll fight them to the death!"

dialogue.content: Warmth bloomed in Chen Ji's heart, but he pretended to be disgusted and knocked on his sister's forehead: "With your little bit of skill, fight someone?" He paused, his gaze inadvertently sweeping across Chen Nian's waist, his pupils slightly contracting. There hung a lustrous jade pendant, of excellent quality, certainly not something an ordinary farming family could possess. He asked casually without changing his expression: "Where did this jade pendant come from?"

Chen Nian glanced down at the jade pendant, a hint of unnaturalness flickering in her eyes before she quickly put on an unconcerned smile: "This? It... it was given by the family. Brother, stop changing the subject, let me ask you—" She leaned close to Chen Ji, lowering her voice, her expression turning serious, "Did you get into some kind of trouble? Last time Mom sent a letter saying a lot of strangers suddenly came to our house, and they had Holy Sect tokens..."

text.content: Holy Sect. Chen Ji's heart tensed, though his expression remained unchanged. The Chen family was merely an ordinary farmer's household in a remote small town, with no connections to the three great sects—why would the Holy Sect come to their door? He invited his sister to sit, personally poured her a cup of warm water, his tone gentle yet carrying an unavoidable seriousness: "Little Nian, tell me everything about what's happening at home, don't leave out a single word."

dialogue.content: Chen Nian cradled the water cup, her expression complex as she spoke: "Those people said... said that the Chen family's ancestors have some connection to the Holy Sect, and now they want to acknowledge their lineage. Although Mom and Dad are simple folk, they also thought this was a good thing—after all, the Holy Sect is so powerful..." She bit her lip, her voice dropping several notches, "They also said they would arrange a marriage for me, with a senior brother from the Holy Sect."

text.content: The words fell, and the room fell into dead silence. Chen Ji's eyes deepened abruptly, his knuckles turning white from tension. The Holy Sect's marriage engagement, the Heavenly Fate key—in his mind, these clues rapidly connected, a terrible speculation taking shape. He took a deep breath, suppressing the surging killing intent, his voice still terrifyingly calm: "That senior brother... what's his name?"

dialogue.content: Chen Nian shook her head: "They didn't say his name, only that I should meet the person first, and on the first day of next month, I'll go to the Holy Sect's main temple..." She suddenly grasped Chen Ji's hand, her eyes full of trust and determination, "Brother, I know you'll find a way, won't you? I've believed in you since we were little. Those people called you a废物, but they're the blind ones! In my heart, my brother will always be the most capable person!"

text.content: In that moment, Chen Ji felt something violently churning in his chest. Guilt, heartache, rage, warmth... various emotions intertwined, almost breaking through the cold facade he had carefully constructed. He thought of the Tianji Record's prophecy, of his sister's blurred figure, of the words "fatal backlash of fate." He could not let his sister become a sacrifice in this chess game—never.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's words left Chen Ji with a turmoil of emotions. Faced with his sister being sent to the Holy Sect, he needed to make a decision.

choices.text: Set up a secret scheme to block the marriage
choices.description: Tell his sister he already has arrangements and will never let her marry into the Holy Sect. Show protectiveness but don't reveal the plan.
choices.visible_cost: May expose his strength and attract the Holy Sect's attention
choices.visible_reward: Reassure his sister and temporarily delay the crisis
choices.risk_hint: If pressed by his sister for details, he might slip up

text.content: Chen Ji reached out and rubbed the top of his sister's head, his gesture more tender than usual. "Rest easy—this marriage won't happen." His voice was low and resolute, as if declaring an unchangeable fact. Chen Nian愣了一下, then her eyes reddened again, but not from sadness—she knew that if her brother said it like this, he would find a way.

choices.description: Secretly awaken Mo Xiansheng from the Tianji Record Fragment to ask about the connection between his sister and the Holy Sect, obtaining key intelligence.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain important clues about the Holy Sect's layout
choices.risk_hint: Using the Tianji Record will accelerate the fatal backlash of fate

text.content: Chen Ji found an excuse to stand up, turned his back to Chen Nian, and quietly pressed his fingertips onto the Tianji Record Fragment. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul rippled slightly, an aged voice sounding in his mind: "You've finally noticed... the jade pendant on that girl is an ancient sealing object. The Holy Sect doesn't want a marriage—they want what's inside her body. Be careful, don't alarm the enemy."

choices.text: Reveal partial truth to his sister
choices.description: Tell Chen Nian that the Holy Sect has ulterior motives, making her vigilant, but hide the existence of the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: Sister may act impulsively and expose that she knows the truth
choices.visible_reward: Enhance sister's alertness and facilitate future cooperation
choices.risk_hint: Sister's straightforward personality may make it hard to keep secrets

text.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, deciding to reveal part of the truth. He told his sister that the Holy Sect's visit probably had hidden purposes, and that marriage was more like a cover. After hearing this, Chen Nian nodded solemnly: "I knew it couldn't be that simple... Brother, don't worry, I'll be careful." Her gaze was far more resolute than Chen Ji had anticipated.

After a long night conversation, Chen Nian finally showed signs of fatigue, yet still refused to leave. She curled up beside Chen Ji, just like when they were children, resting her head on his shoulder as she fell into a deep sleep. Moonlight filtered through the window frame, illuminating her peaceful features. Chen Ji had no desire to sleep at all. He stared at the jade pendant at his sister's waist, the Tianji Record Fragment in his mind faintly humming. He reached out to touch that jade pendant, but the moment his fingertips approached, he felt a strange repulsive force.

This repulsive force... same origin as the Tianji Record? Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, an even more terrifying speculation forming in his mind. He dared not act rashly, only gently draping his outer robe over his sister, sighing silently into the darkness. Sister, what secrets do you carry? Why is the Holy Sect so fixated on you? And why... does your existence make the Tianji Record's visions grow blurry?

dialogue.content: When dawn began to lighten the sky, Chen Nian slowly awoke. She rubbed her eyes and saw her brother gazing blankly out the window, his expression bearing a heavy gravity she had never seen before. "Brother?" she called softly. Chen Ji snapped back to reality, his expression already restored to its usual state. "Awake? Be careful on the road, don't let anyone see you." He fished out an unremarkable talisman from under his pillow and stuffed it into his sister's palm, "Keep it close to your body—if there's danger, crush it."

text.content: Chen Nian nodded vigorously, clutching the talisman tightly in her hand. She stood up and straightened her clothes, walked to the window, then turned back for a deep look at her brother: "Brother, wait for me to come back." The window frame creaked, and her figure vanished into the morning light. Chen Ji watched that fading silhouette and suddenly spoke: "Little Nian." She turned back, only to hear Chen Ji say flatly: "No matter what happens, survive and wait for me."

choice.prompt: After Chen Nian left, Chen Ji needed to decide his next course of action. His sister's safety tugged at his heartstrings, but acting hastily might alert the enemy.

choices.text: Secretly follow his sister's return journey
choices.description: Personally escort his sister for part of the journey while observing whether the Holy Sect has set ambushes, also searching for more clues.
choices.visible_cost: May expose his whereabouts and attract the attention of watchers
choices.visible_reward: Grasp the Holy Sect's movements and gain time for arrangement
choices.risk_hint: If discovered following her, his sister's situation may become even more dangerous

text.content: Chen Ji's figure flickered, silently tracking his sister's silhouette. He deliberately maintained distance, using the morning fog to conceal his aura, tailing her all the way to ten li outside the town. After confirming no abnormalities, he stealthily returned, already beginning to calculate his next chess move.

choices.text: Contact Ye Qing to obtain intelligence
choices.description: Through special channels contact Demon Path Saintess Ye Qing, asking her to use Demon Path forces to investigate Holy Sect movements.
choices.visible_cost: Owe Ye Qing a favor and weaken autonomy
choices.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence from within the Holy Sect and possibly find a way to break the marriage
choices.risk_hint: Demon Path forces intervening may complicate the situation further

text.content: Chen Ji took out a black jade slip and activated it with a special technique. After a moment, a cold voice rang in his mind: "Missing me already, Chen Gongzi?" Ye Qing's teasing carried genuine undertones, "Go on then—what do you need me to investigate this time?"

choices.text: Do nothing and observe the situation
choices.description: Don't alert the enemy, wait until his sister arrives at the Holy Sect before making plans, using this time to secretly accumulate strength.
choices.visible_cost: Sister may encounter danger during her time at the Holy Sect
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength and avoid early exposure, gaining more time for arrangement
choices.risk_hint: If the Holy Sect acts early, may miss the opportunity to rescue

text.content: Chen Ji watched his sister leave, then turned back into the room. He sat cross-legged and forced himself to calm down. Now was not the time to act—acting rashly would only put his sister in greater danger. He closed his eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment faintly glowing in his consciousness, calculating every step ahead.

As the morning fog dispersed, sunlight fell upon Chen Ji but couldn't dispel the gloom between his brows. He suddenly remembered something and hurried to the window, his gaze falling on where Chen Nian had stood moments ago. There—in the slanting morning light—lingered a faint spiritual energy fluctuation, resonating with the Tianji Record Fragment at his waist. More importantly, on the ground lay a strand of barely noticeable thread, having fallen from that jade pendant.

Chen Ji bent down and picked up the thread, and the moment his fingertips touched it, a familiar, heart-stopping aura flooded his consciousness. This was... turtle shell material fiber? Identical to the carrier of the Tianji Record Fragment! He clenched the thread tightly, his heart pounding like a war drum. His sister's jade pendant, same origin as the Tianji Record. Did the Holy Sect find her by coincidence, or did they always know about her connection to the Tianji Record?

choice.prompt: The jade pendant's secret left Chen Ji deep in thought. His sister's connection to the Tianji Record was far more complex than he had imagined. He needed to decide whether to investigate this clue in depth.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record Fragment to analyze this thread's origin and connections, possibly consuming Heavenly Fate but obtaining key intelligence.
choices.visible_reward: Reveal part of the connection between the jade pendant and the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Using the Tianji Record again may intensify the fatal backlash of fate

text.content: Chen Ji placed the thread in his palm, and the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly burst forth with a ghostly blue light. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: "This is the 'Thread of Heavenly Fate,' transformed from the leftover materials used to forge the Tianji Record. The jade pendant on your sister's body was probably forged from the same source as the fragment in your hand." He paused, "The Chen family... may not be the ordinary farmer's household you thought."

choices.text: First preserve the clue and wait for the right moment
choices.description: Carefully store the thread and conduct deeper research when investigating the Chen family's secrets later, avoiding premature exposure of knowledge.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily lose the opportunity for deeper understanding
choices.visible_reward: Preserve important physical evidence that can serve as a key bargaining chip later
choices.risk_hint: If the thread's aura leaks out, it may be noticed by those with ulterior motives

text.content: Chen Ji carefully placed the thread into a jade bottle that隔绝 spiritual energy and hid it in his close-fitting hidden pocket. He raised his eyes to the horizon, a glint of determination flickering within. Whatever secrets his sister carried, he would investigate thoroughly. But before that moment arrived, he needed more bargaining chips, greater strength—and an absolutely flawless plan.

choices.description: Ling Yuan has been "kindly protecting" Chen Ji, perhaps knowing some secrets about the Chen family and the Tianji Record. Could take the opportunity to probe.
choices.visible_cost: May alert the enemy and make Ling Yuan vigilant
choices.visible_reward: May obtain key intelligence and even see through Ling Yuan's true stance
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is extremely scheming, probing may backfire and get oneself used

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered, a thought emerging. The old fox had always shown him "great care"—he probably knew something long ago. Rather than waiting passively, better to take the initiative and probe. He straightened his clothes, put on an expression of timidity, and headed toward the leader's residence—it was time to perform.

The jade pendant gleamed with an eerie light under the moonlight, its turtle shell material identical to the Tianji Record Fragment—Chen Ji's heart lurched, a terrifying thought emerging: was there some connection between his sister and the Tianji Record that he had never known about? The morning breeze brushed past, scattering the loose hair on his forehead, but couldn't disperse the clouds of doubt in his heart. Between the Chen family, the Holy Sect, and the Tianji Record—what earth-shaking secret lies hidden?
